findings.message: 6 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "SERVICES" above "Build Smarter, Scale Faster"; "Artificial Intelligence" above "AI"; "WHY CHOOSE US" above "One Partner. findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 15 gradient fill(s): div.section-background.partner-brands__background → linear-gradient(105deg, rgb(170, 197, 255) 2.81%, rgb(203, 213, 253) 97.19%) | div.services-globe.color-custom-services-template--279429110 → linear-gradient(123.856deg, rgb(148, 184, 255) 27.224%, rgb(225, 223, 255) 99.351%) | div.section-background.product-solutions-grid__background → radial-gradient(54.79% 79.25% at 48.72% 36.96%, rgb(197, 217, 255) 14.56%, rgb(169, 196, 255) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 10 gradient-filled text element(s).
findings.fix: Solid colour text.

findings.message: 3 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.insight-row → rgba(60, 69, 232, 0.25) 3px 4px 12.1px 0px | a.insight-row → rgba(60, 69, 232, 0.25) 3px 4px 12.1px 0px | a.insight-row → rgba(60, 69, 232, 0.25) 3px 4px 12.1px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 1 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.brand-footer__bottom 1302px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 10 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 3 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 2 rows of identical boxed cards.
findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: 1 clip(s) without a poster.
findings.fix: Give every clip a poster frame: in the study of 100 Sites of the Day only 31% had one, and the blank or grey boxes before the clips played were recorded as faults (references/imagery.md §11).

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 132 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 20 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 80px on the left, 20px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.
